##### Project general facts

Flamingo LUX is a boutique residential development by Eminent Real Estate Development. The project features a low-rise structure comprising a ground floor, four residential levels, and a rooftop, offering an exclusive and private living atmosphere within one of the city’s most prestigious and rapidly developing areas. The building’s balanced composition and minimalist aesthetic emphasize sophistication and modernity, allowing it to blend seamlessly into its upscale surroundings while maintaining a distinct visual identity. The development offers a curated selection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as spacious three-bedroom penthouses.

Residents benefit from a wide range of lifestyle amenities, including a rooftop swimming pool with sun deck, a fully equipped gym, yoga and lounge areas, BBQ spaces, children’s play areas, and landscaped walkways. Additional conveniences such as parking, electric vehicle charging stations, and retail access further enhance the comfort and functionality of the project.

The projects' scale and setting create a calm and comfortable environment while maintaining close proximity to key urban destinations. The architecture reflects a contemporary design approach, defined by clean lines, refined geometry, and a light, elegant facade palette. Interiors are designed in a modern style with premium finishes, neutral color schemes, and carefully selected materials. Kitchens are equipped with high-quality European appliances, including an oven, microwave, dishwasher, hob and hood, fridge-freezer, washing machine and dryer, while features such as built-in wardrobes, smart main door locks, ultra-soundproof windows, branded sanitary ware and fittings, central air filtration and water softening systems elevate everyday comfort and wellbeing.

##### Location description and benefits

Nad Al Sheba 1 is a prestigious residential neighborhood in Dubai, known for its serene atmosphere and proximity to key landmarks. The area offers an exclusive living environment with a mix of elegant villas and well-maintained roads lined with lush greenery. Its strategic location provides residents with convenient access to Downtown Dubai, Meydan, and other major destinations within the city.

The community is designed to cater to families and individuals seeking privacy, luxury, and a comfortable lifestyle. Nad Al Sheba 1 boasts spacious villas with high-end architecture and private gardens, creating an ideal setting for tranquil family living. The neighborhood’s planning ensures a peaceful environment, enhanced by beautifully landscaped parks and walking paths.

In addition to its serene residential ambiance, Nad Al Sheba 1 offers easy access to an array of amenities, including schools, healthcare facilities, and retail outlets. Its proximity to Meydan ensures that residents can enjoy world-class dining, entertainment, and sporting events. With a perfect blend of exclusivity, comfort, and convenience, Nad Al Sheba 1 stands out as a highly desirable location in Dubai.
